verses.gurmukhi: ਕਛੂ ਆਂਡਾ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਪਕੁ ਨਦੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: kachhoo aa(n)ddaa dhiaan dhar kar parapak nadhee vich aanai|

en.bdb: Tortoise lays its eggs in the sands but having full care of them on their maturity, it brings them into the river.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੰਜ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਕਰੈ ਲੈ ਬੱਚਾ ਉਡਦੀ ਅਸਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: koo(n)j ridhai simaran karai lai ba'chaa uddadhee asamaanai|

en.bdb: The florican also under its full care makes its offspring fly in the sky.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਤਕ ਬੱਚਾ ਤੁਰਿ ਤੁਰੈ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: batak ba'chaa tur turai jal thal varatai sahaj viddaanai|

en.bdb: The swan also in its very natural way teaches its young ones to move on water as well as on earth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇਲ ਪਾਲੈ ਕਾਵਣੀ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਜਾਇ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: koil paalai kaavanee miladhaa jai kuTa(n)b sin(j)aanai|

en.bdb: The crow maintains the offspring’s of cuckoo but as and when they grow up, they, identifying the voice of their mother, go and meet her.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੰਸ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਸਿ ਮਾਨਸਰਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ha(n)s va(n)s vas maanasar maanak motee chog chugaanai|

en.bdb: The progeny of swans learn to pick up pearls while living in the Manasarovar, the sacred tank.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਰਖੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: giaan dhiaan simaran sadhaa satigur sikh rakhai nirabaanai|

en.bdb: Giving the technique of knowledge, meditation and remembrance to the Sikh, the Guru liberates him forever.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖਹੁਂ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: bhoot bhavikhahu(n) varatamaan tirabhavan sojhee maan nimaanai|

en.bdb: The Sikh now knows the future, present and past but he gets honours by becoming humble.
The ilk of the gurmukhs is grand but people do not know this fact.
